The strict Jury inequalities S>0,P>0,Q>0 give a contracting return; numerator signs N0,N1>0 and the positive-square N2 establish LLR admissibility. The displayed boundary strip follows by substitution and continuity. Rational checks of the witness corroborate but do not replace the algebra.
